name: 08620 · Yardville, NJ
findings: ZIP 08620 (Yardville) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08620 (Yardville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
